LESSON: READING FOR COMPREHENSI ON

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 5: Fun and Enjoyment: My Birthday
Topic 2.6: Reading for Comprehensi on
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Comprehensi on, part of READING Theme 5: Fun and Enjoyment: My Birthday in Grade 4 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: When do you read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out a list of healthy and unhealthy foods they like,

2. read charts with pictures of food items and their names in German,

3. match pictures of food items with their names and read them out loud,

4. work with peers to come up with and name food mashes, salads and cocktails and read their names out loud e.g Banareis (Banane +Reis),Orapf(Orangen+Apfel),Co lmil (Cola+Milch,

5. read texts on food items and answer a few simple comprehension questions.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out a list of healthy and unhealthy foods they like,
2. read charts with pictures of food items and their names in German,
3. match pictures of food items with their names and read them out loud,
4. work with peers to come up with and name food mashes, salads and cocktails and read their names out loud e.g Banareis (Banane +Reis),Orapf(Orangen+Apfel),Co lmil (Cola+Milch,
5. read texts on food items and answer a few simple comprehension questions.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Comprehensi on together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: The learner demonstrates the skills of exploration and coming up with unique and new ideas

when they come up with food mashes, salads and cocktails.

Values:
Unity: The learner works collaboratively as they work with peers to come up with and name food mashes, salads and

cocktails and read their names out loud.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health education: The learner develops an awareness of healthy eating when they list healthy and unhealthy food items.
